title: Kaizen workflow schema
description: Declarative workflow definition. Lives at schemas/<name>/schema.yaml (built-in), .workflow/schemas/<name>/schema.yaml (project), or ~/.claude/kaizen-schemas/<name>/schema.yaml (user). Consumed by skills/workflow-routing/scripts/workflow_runner.py.

name.description: Kebab id, matches the schema directory name.

id.description: Unique within this schema; referenced by other artifacts' .requires[].

generates.description: Output path or glob this artifact produces.

template.description: Relative path to the artifact's template (under <schema-dir>/templates/), or null for code-only stages.

requires.description: Artifact ids that must complete before this one. DAG edges.

branch_high.description: v1.15.0+: Confidence-Score routing — stages to run when confidence > 85%. Splice via workflow.sh branch <id> high.

branch_medium.description: Stages to run on medium confidence (66–85%).

branch_low.description: Stages to run on low confidence (<66%).

gate.description: Artifact id whose completion gates implementation.

progress.description: File path that tracks progress (typically a checkbox list).
